{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vectinian spider''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] from the [[Vectinia system/Legends|Vectinia system]]. It produced a [[Silk/Legends|silk]] that was commonly used in conjunction with [[alcomase]] for the manufacture of [[thermal cape]]s.
